name: 645. Kimi cache write priced at the requested TTL rate (kimi cache ttl pricing)

item.name: /v1/chat/completions - prompt_cache_options.ttl 1h: logged cost takes the 1-hour cache-write rate, usage unchanged - moonshot/kimi-k3

exec: // A fresh prefix per run, long enough for Kimi to write it to its prompt cache.
for (var i = 0; i < 400; i++) { lines.push('Clause ' + i + ': the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.'); }
// TXE-7069: Kimi bills a cache write by the request's prompt_cache_options.ttl and reports one cache_write_tokens figure.
// Bifrost's own cost must take the write at the rate of the TTL asked for, and usage must stay as Kimi reported it (contract C5): no tier derived from the request.
pm.test(LABEL + ': request succeeds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + pm.response.text()).to.eql(200); });
pm.test(LABEL + ': usage carries no cache-write tier derived from the request', function () {
pm.test(LABEL + ': Kimi reported a cache write, so the rate is exercised', function () {
pm.expect(write, 'no cache write reported (raise the prefix length in the pre-request script): ' + JSON.stringify(u)).to.be.above(0);
var expected = (u.prompt_tokens - read - write) * RATES.input + read * RATES.cacheRead + write * TTL_WRITE_RATE + u.completion_tokens * RATES.output;
pm.test(LABEL + ': x-bifrost-request-id echoed', function () { pm.expect(reqId, 'x-bifrost-request-id header').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
// /api is locked behind the setup token on the harness profile; pm.sendRequest does not inherit the collection header.
var logHeaders = setupToken ? [{ key: 'X-Bifrost-Setup-Token', value: setupToken }] : [];
// The log row is written by the batching writer, so poll the logs API. Bounded: ten reads a second apart.
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/logs/' + reqId, method: 'GET', header: logHeaders }, function (err, res) {
pm.test(LABEL + ': logged cost prices the cache write at the requested TTL rate', function () {
pm.expect(cb.total_cost, 'expected ' + expected + ' for usage ' + JSON.stringify(u) + ', cost_breakdown: ' + JSON.stringify(cb)).to.be.closeTo(expected, expected * 1e-6);
pm.test(LABEL + ': log row appeared', function () { pm.expect.fail('log ' + reqId + ' never appeared: ' + (err ? String(err) : (res.code + ' ' + res.text()))); });
